title: Anti-rug numeric settings: an empty LP_REMOVAL_PCT or CONFIRM_BLOCKS silently becomes 0, GAS_MULTIPLIER has no upper bound, and WATCHDOG_BUDGET_MS turns a unit suffix into a tiny number

evidence.note: process.env[KEY] ?? default keeps an empty string; Number("") is 0, accepted by the 0..100 check, so signal 1 trips on any LP decrease
CONFIRM_BLOCKS "" becomes 0, accepted, so dispatch is immediate with no confirmation
GAS_MULTIPLIER must be >= 1.0 and has no upper bound
the breaker window must be an integer number of hours
parseInt("60s") is 60, so WATCHDOG_BUDGET_MS=60s gives a 60 ms budget: every live anti-rug exit is reported failed at once and counted by the breaker while the sell runs unbounded in the background

sibling_sites_checked: Every anti-rug env read: chainRegistry.ts:721-861 (LIVE_EXECUTE, LP_REMOVAL_PCT, CONFIRM_BLOCKS, CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERS, CIRCUIT_BREAKER_WINDOW_HOURS, GAS_MULTIPLIER, BACKFILL_CAP_BLOCKS, MAX_BACKFILL_BLOCKS), :881-932 (ALLOWLIST_EXTRA, _V2, _V3), exitTrigger.ts:78 (WATCHDOG_BUDGET_MS, also read by the worker watchdog in bot.ts, BUY row TH-BUY-14). Empty TRIGGERS, WINDOW, GAS_MULTIPLIER, BACKFILL_CAP and MAX_BACKFILL become 0 and fail loud (exit 1), which is correct.
severity_rationale: S2: needs an operator configuration mistake, but the mistakes are ordinary (an empty line in .env, a unit suffix) and the effects are silent: emergency sells on any LP movement, no confirmation, an unbounded gas bid, or every exit reported failed. Bounded per position.
recommendation: Treat an empty value as unset or reject it; reject 0 for LP_REMOVAL_PCT; cap GAS_MULTIPLIER; parse durations strictly (Number and an integer check) and fail loud. How strict is card ANTIRUG-07. Phase 24.
